subject: Micro-transaction Pilot: PO Flexibility Request and Conditions
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@payflux.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: PayFlux Procurement <procurement@payflux.io>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at PayFlux is excited about the integration. We're planning a small pilot to validate settlement latency for a subset of our merchant customers (roughly $1–5k/mo in invoiced usage during the pilot).

Operationally, our procurement team prefers standard POs, but given the size and speed of this pilot we wanted to ask whether Redwood can support an invoice-only onboarding path (no PO) for the first 60 days. We'll complete your vendor form and SOW, and can provide a credit card on file or a net-15 invoice with confirmation of payment.

Can you outline what approvals you'd need and any guardrails (invoice limits, required contacts, audit artifacts)? I've attached the completed vendor intake form and a draft SOW for reference.

Attachments: payflux_vendor_form.pdf (vendor intake), payflux_sow_draft.docx (SOW draft)

Appreciate the quick guidance — Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships | PayFlux
elena.ruiz@payflux.io
+1 415-555-0198
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@payflux.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the forms.

Short answer: we can support a temporary invoice-only path for a limited pilot, but Procurement needs to sign off on the controls. To move this forward I suggest the following minimal approval criteria: 
- Pilot capped at $7,500 total spend over 60 days
- Dedicated billing contact and invoice schedule (PayFlux to confirm net-15 or credit card)
- Completed vendor intake and proof of entity (we have the form)
- Redwood retains right to require PO if spend or scope changes

Could you confirm expected monthly run-rate and which payment method you'll use? I'll loop in Marissa (Finance) for final sign-off and Karthik for the legal checklist on SOW consistency.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
1) PayFlux confirms payment method and expected pilot spend (Elena) — by EOD Tue
2) Redwood Finance & Procurement review and provide temporary approval with conditions (Marissa) — target Wed
3) Execute SOW amendment indicating 60-day invoice-only pilot, then start integration (Jonas/Karthik)

Happy to escalate if you need a faster turnaround.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@payflux.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: PayFlux Procurement <procurement@payflux.io>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Thanks Jonas — confirmed details below:
- Expected pilot run-rate: $3,200/month (estimated 2 months)
- Payment method: net-15 invoice with ACH; procurement can provide remittance details after onboarding
- Our procurement contact is Marco Santos (procurement@payflux.io) — he is CC'd on this thread for any follow-up.

We agree to the guardrails you listed. We can also include a clause in the SOW that states Redwood may require a PO at any time if monthly spend exceeds $8,000 or the pilot scope expands.

Forwarding the vendor intake and SOW again in case Marissa needs the originals.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@payflux.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot — Temporary Approval

Jonas / Elena — thanks for the details and for laying out the guardrails. Procurement (Finance) will approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding path under the following conditions: 

1) Total pilot spend must not exceed $8,000 in the 60-day window.
2) PayFlux to provide ACH remittance details and a named billing contact before any invoices are issued.
3) Redwood Finance will issue a formal temporary approval memo (attached) that must be included in the vendor file.
4) If at any time monthly billed charges exceed $8k or scope materially expands (additional merchants or regions), Redwood will require a PO and transition to standard procurement flow.

I've attached the signed temporary approval memo (procurement_temp_approval.pdf). Karthik — please confirm no redlines are needed to the SOW amendment; otherwise we can proceed to execute the SOW as amended to reference the 60-day invoice-only pilot.

Elena — once you send remittance details I'll create the vendor record and route the first invoice through our AR queue.

Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: procurement_temp_approval.pdf
